verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents importing objects together with pre-computed vector embeddings, which covers the import half of the story. There is no documented bulk-export path in a documented, portable format. The backup feature (to S3, GCS or Azure, restorable across providers) is a backup/restore mechanism, not an export, so it gets only adjacent credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch import specifics and file formats, a bulk-export capability for vectors plus metadata in a documented format, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import and bulk-export vectors plus metadata in documented formats
